C. I. D.
R. O. S. S
No 269
3/6/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

3rd June 191 3

Sir,
Woo Cha Leh 吴嘉禄 the officer who led the rebel
attack on Wukiang near Soochow, visited the family of
the late Chen Chi Mei yesterday, and offered his condolences.
It is reported that the Chapei gentry intend to
petition Chiangchun Feng Kuo Chang to remove the Northern
soldiers from their district.
It is reported that Woo Chi Mei 胡奇梅, compradore
of the Banque Belge Pour L'Etranger, has given $500.00
to certain rebels who reside at No. 156 Avenue Joffre in
aid of the revolutionary cause.
It is rumoured that the Government and Chekiang
soldiers have come into collision at Fung Ching where
they exchanged shots.
Nine hundred soldiers arrived at the Hweichow Guild
which is situated south of St. Catherine's Bridge, from
Anhweim on June 2nd. These troops were brought here by
the cruiser Yoong Ziang, and it is said they will take
part in the attack on Chekiang.
It is reported that the rebels are arranging to hold
a conference in Shanghai.
The Chapei and City Police were all paid yesterday.

Your obedient servant,

William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered am S. June 3.

刑事侦缉处
收文登记
第 269 号
1916年6月3日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1913年6月3日

先生：

吴嘉禄（Woo Cha Leh），即率领叛军袭击苏州附近吴江的军官，昨日拜访了已故陈其美（Chen Chi Mei）的家属，并致以慰问。

据报，闸北士绅拟向江苏督军冯国璋（Chiangchun Feng Kuo Chang）请愿，要求将其辖区内的北军撤走。

据报，比华银行（Banque Belge Pour L'Etranger）买办胡奇梅（Woo Chi Mei）已向居住在霞飞路156号的某些叛党人士提供500.00元，以资助革命事业。

有谣言称，政府军与浙军在枫泾（Fung Ching）发生冲突，双方交火。

6月2日，九百名士兵从安徽抵达位于圣凯瑟琳桥以南的徽州会馆。这些部队由“永翔”号巡洋舰（Yoong Ziang）运抵此处，据悉他们将参与对浙江的进攻。

据报，叛党正安排在上海举行会议。

闸北及南市警队于昨日全部发饷。

您顺从的仆人，

威廉·阿姆斯特朗（William Armstrong）
首席探长

警务处总监

上午录入。6月3日。
